No charge time required when in Photon Reforge state.

Tips: Great for reducing enemies' Resilience while dealing area damage.

Charges and fires Photon Arrows to a target area, dealing continuous Attack DMG. The damage interval scales with Attack SPD.
While in Photon Reforge state, Photon Arrows consume no Photon Energy, generate extra arrows, and deal 50% more Attack DMG.

Tips: Casting during Photon Reforge increases its damage and consumes no Photon Energy.

2235.Desc:

Summon Falcon: The summoned Falcon dives in a straight line, dealing Attack DMG to all enemies in its path before disappearing.

Tips: Boosts the number of active Companions during the battle. Casting is recommended when all buffs are prepared to ensure maximum efficiency.

2301.Desc:
Peaceful Tune
A magical melody that, whenever DMG is dealt, restores HP equal to 20% of the DMG dealt, distributed evenly among up to 5 allies (Party Members Prioritized).
Allies at full HP will not be included in the healing targets. If all Allies are at full HP, the healing will be considered as excess healing.
Performance Energy: Energy required to play Melody skills (Heroic Melody and Healing Melody). 1 point is regenerated per second.
Performance Passion: Required to perform music. 1 point is regenerated every 5s.

Basic Attack: Resonant Strings
Strums the strings to emit a scorching soundwave, dealing long-range Magic DMG to the enemy.

Tips: Using Basic Attacks when Performance Passion and Performance Energy are not maxed out provides consistent healing. Pair with talents to store this healing for emergency use.
2301.Name: Resonant Strings

2306.Desc:
Consumes 3 Performance Passion to swing your guitar with force, dealing heavy Magic DMG to enemies.

Performance Passion: Required to perform music. Regenerates 1 stack every 5s.

Tips: High coverage healing skill. Use it before your Performance Passion overflows.
2306.Name: Amplified Beat

2307.Desc:
Consumes 3 stacks of Performance Passion to play a tune that heals the caster and the nearby ally with the lowest HP (party members prioritized). The healing amount scales with the caster's MATK (plus an additional fixed heal equal to 3% of the target's Max HP).

Performance Passion: Required to perform music. 1 point is regenerated every 5s.

Tips: A healing skill with high uptime. Cast it to avoid letting Performance Passion overflow.
2307.Name: Healing Beat

2308.Desc:
Leaps high and slams your guitar into the ground to burst sparks, dealing Magic DMG to the enemies within range.
Each instance of DMG dealt by Amplified Beat (only once per multi-target hit) increases the hit count of Harmonic Anthem by 1, up to 3.

Tips: Master the Amplified Beat's mechanic of increasing hit count to boost Harmonic Anthem's Attack.
2308.Name: Harmonic Anthem

2309.Desc:
My Passion Still Burns! Consumes 5 stacks of Performance Passion to summon a randomly shaped graffiti on the ground, healing 10 allies (party members prioritized) and dealing Magic DMG to the enemies within range.
While standing within the graffiti, the caster gains 10% Fire Bonus.
Only 1 graffiti can exist at a time.

Performance Passion: Required to perform music. 1 point is regenerated every 5s.

Tips: This skill has the widest range for both healing and DMG. Cast it once the CD ends for max effectiveness.
2309.Name: Rhapsody of Flame

2310.Desc:
A rousing melody. When Performance Energy exceeds 15 stacks, you can begin the performance, which cannot be stopped once started. CD: 5s.
While performing Heroic Melody, you consume 6 Performance Energy per second, and every 3s, 10 allies restore HP (Interval affected by Haste).
While you perform Heroic Melody, every 7s, your String Strike transforms into Fierce Strike.
While you perform Heroic Melody, the conversion rate of Peaceful Tune +50%.

Performance Energy: Required to play Melody skills (Heroic Melody and Healing Melody). 1 point of energy is regenerated per second.

Tips: The skill can't be stopped manually, so time its activation wisely to maximize synergy with Peaceful Tune and Fierce Strike.
2310.Name: Heroic Melody

2311.Desc:
A soothing melody. When Performance Energy exceeds 15, you can start the performance freely and stop at will. Each time you start, a speaker is deployed to perform a Concerto. (Speaker disappears when Healing Melody ends.) CD: 5s.
While performing Healing Melody, consumes 3 Performance Energy per second, and heals 10 allies every 1 second (Interval affected by Haste).

Speaker: When you cast Healing Beat, Fivefold Crescendo, Rock the Stage, Concert Circuit, the speaker will simultaneously cast the same skill.

Performance Energy: Required to play Melody skills (Heroic Melody, Healing Melody). Regenerates 1 point per second.

Tips: Mastering where and when to place the speaker is essential.
2311.Name: Healing Melody

2312.Desc:
Let the passion surge again! Consumes 3 Performance Passion, reigniting the spirits of the weary. Performs a sequence of notes that restores HP to 10 allies within range (prioritizing teammates) and grants Tenacity Chord. Each stack of Tenacity Chord additionally increases Max HP by 0.5% (up to 2.5% Max HP) for 5s (duration cannot be refreshed once 5 stacks are reached).

Performance Passion: Required to perform music. Regenerates 1 stack every 5s.

Tips: Highest healing potential. Monitor your team's health to maximize efficiency and prevent overhealing.
2312.Name: Fivefold Crescendo

2313.Desc:
Strums the strings and releases searing flames forward, dealing Magic DMG to the enemies within range.
Charging alters the skill's range and DMG.
Tier 1: Chants for 0.7s, targeting a fan-shaped area with an 8-meter radius in front.
Tier 2: Chants for 1.4s, targeting a fan-shaped area with an 8-meter radius in front and increasing DMG by 50%.
Tier 3: Chants for 2.1s, targeting a fan-shaped area with an 8-meter radius in front and increasing DMG by 100%.

Tips: High DMG skill. Combine with Talent effects and the amplifier for strong DMG and healing. Be mindful of environmental safety during casting.
2313.Name: Passion Burst

2314.Desc:
As a passionate music lover, your impromptu performance immediately grants 5 Performance Passion. It also heals nearby allies and gives them a Shield that lasts for 10s, while dealing Magic DMG to nearby enemies.
Performance Passion: Required to perform music. Regenerates 1 stack every 5s.

Tips: In emergencies, this powerful shield can ease the team's survival pressure. Time the cast carefully.
2314.Name: Rock the Stage

2315.Desc:
The perfect piece for fan interaction. Grants Encore effect to 10 allies for 10s.
Encore: Grants Super Armor. Each time an offensive or healing Expertise Skill is cast, there is a 50% fixed chance to trigger Encore Strings once, dealing DMG to the current target or healing the lowest-HP ally.

Tips: Cast during your team's burst window for optimal DMG and healing of Encore.
2315.Name: Encore

2316.Desc:
Increases your MATK for a period of time and amplifies the next skill you cast.

Special Attack: Your next 2 Special Attacks do not consume Performance Passion.
Fivefold Crescendo: Doubles the healing instances.
Heroic Melody: Halves the time needed to trigger Fierce Strike.
Harmonic Anthem: Doubles the DMG dealt.
Passion Burst: Allows for direct cast in its strongest form, no chanting required.

Tips: Evaluate the battle environment and your combat style, then apply the appropriate enhancement at the optimal moment.
2316.Name: Center Stage

2317.Desc:
Swings your guitar with force, dealing Magic DMG equal to 300% ATK to nearby enemies. Harmonic Anthem instantly gains 1 charge. Scales with the Level/Tier of Basic Attack.

Tips: Cast this skill when Harmonic Anthem is on CD.
2317.Name: Fierce Strike

2321.Desc:
Peaceful Tune
A magical melody that, whenever DMG is dealt, restores HP equal to 20% of the DMG dealt, distributed evenly among up to 5 allies (Party Members Prioritized).
Allies at full HP will not be included in the healing targets. If all Allies are at full HP, the healing will be considered as excess healing.

Performance Energy: Energy required to play Melody skills (Heroic Melody and Healing Melody). 1 point is regenerated per second.

Performance Passion: Required to perform music. 1 point is regenerated every 5s.

Basic Attack: String Strike
Strikes the guitar's sideboard to produce a frenzied wave, dealing Magic DMG to nearby enemies.

Tips: Using Basic Attacks when Performance Passion and Performance Energy are not maxed out provides consistent healing. Pair with talents to store this healing for emergency use.
2321.Name: String Strike

2330.Name: 场地标记01
2330.NameDesign: 灵魂乐手炎舞奏者强化

2332.Desc:
Channels for 6s and continuously spews searing flames forward, dealing Magic DMG equal to 1000% ATK in total to the enemies within range.

Tips: Move continuously and try to maximize DMG dealt while staying safe.
2332.Name: Passion Fury

2335.Desc:
Instantly releases a powerful sonic wave, dealing Magic DMG to nearby enemies. Heals nearby allies and grants a Shield that lasts for 10s. Doubles the Performance Passion cap and fully restores Performance Passion.

Performance Passion: Required to perform music. Regenerates 1 stack every 5s.

Tips: A powerful emergency shield to ease team survival pressure. Time the cast carefully. Once fully charged with Performance Passion, trigger burst.
2335.Name: Infinite Rhapsody

2336.Desc:
A mobile performance melody. While performing, continuously heals allies. Deals Magic DMG to nearby enemies. Each healed ally increases healing by 6%, up to 30%. Each enemy hit increases DMG by 6%, up to 30%.

Tips: Sustained healing and DMG. Adjust your position based on the number and location of targets to maximize efficiency.
2336.Name: Concert Circuit

2401.Desc:
Holy Sigil
Resource required to cast Special Attacks and some Expertise. There are 5 initial Holy Sigils. Each Holy Sigil enters a 10s CD after being consumed, and generates 10 Photon Energy.

Photon Energy
Resource required to cast some Expertise, starting at a max of 100.

Basic Attack: Blade of Justice
Unleashes a 3-hit sword combo followed by a Swing, each hit dealing Attack DMG.
2401.Name: Blade of Justice

2405.Desc:
Consumes 1 Holy Sigil to deliver a powerful shield bash to enemies in front, dealing Attack DMG and increasing your Armor, stacking up to 3 times.

Tips: Monitor the Armor buff from Valor Bash and try to keep it active at all times.
2405.Name: Valor Bash

2406.Desc:
Consumes 1 Holy Sigil. After a brief charge, performs a fierce sweep forward, dealing Attack DMG and gaining 2 stacks of Lightforged Barrier.

Lightforged Barrier: Each stack increases max HP by 2%, up to 10 stacks. Taking any DMG consumes 1 stack. The Barrier lasts 25s or until all stacks are consumed. Gaining a new stack refreshes the duration.

Tips: Maintain high stacks of Lightforged Barrier while weaving in attacks. Pay attention to the use of Vanguard Hunt to trigger bonus effects.
2406.Name: Vanguard Strike

2407.Desc:
Unleashes holy energy to strike nearby enemies, dealing Attack DMG and inflicting Dazzle for 5s. Grants a Radiant Shield equal to 300% ATK. For the next 10s, instantly refreshes 1 Holy Sigil for every 2s (prioritizing the Holy Sigil with the longest remaining CD), and generates 10 Photon Energy each time.

Radiant Shield: Infuses the Shield with light, absorbing 50% of incoming DMG. The effect can stack absorption and reset duration when the Skill is reused. Max absorption cannot exceed 100% of Max HP.

Tips: Instantly boosts survivability and generates Holy Sigil and Photon Energy. Time the casts wisely.
2407.Name: Radiant Infusion

2408.Desc:
Spins and throws a shield, dealing Attack DMG to enemies hit, interrupting them, and reducing all DMG they deal to the caster for the next 10s.

Tips: While improving survivability, it performs well in multi-target situations with its wide-area DMG. Cast it according to your survival conditions or the battle environment.

Upon the skill cast, your Crit and Crit DMG are increased for a period.

3905.Desc:
Summons Elite: Boarrier Tyrant to charge forward with tusks for 3s. Deals Attack DMG and knocks enemies airborne during the charge. Boarrier tusks tear through flesh, inflicting 100% Wound on enemies hit for 15s.
Upon the skill cast, the DMG dealt and healing of your Special Attack are increased for a period.
3905.Name: Stunt! Boarrier Rush

3906.Desc:
Summons Boss: Frost Ogre to execute a spinning attack with an ice hammer, resulting in Attack DMG and freezing all targets on hit.
Upon the skill cast, your Resilience Break Bonus is increased for a period.

3907.Desc:

3913.Desc:

Summons Elite: Goblin Warrior to shoot in a fan-shaped area in front, dealing Attack DMG.

3917.Name: Stunt! Heavy Slash

3918.Desc: [Boss Summon] - Crimson Foxen. Strike instantly, dealing 1 instance of <style="physical">Attack DMG</style>. Then it continues assisting the player in combat for <style="accent-gn">15s</style>. Can be directed via Storm Arrow from the Marksman.

3920.Name: Arcane! Blessing of Life

3922.Desc: <style="accent-gn">Summons</style> Olvera to shuttle back and forth in a forward direction, drawing in enemies encountered along the path, dealing <style="physical">Attack DMG</style>, and <linktext=3000><style="ItemQuality_5">interrupting</style></linktext> their actions. Dealing DMG to targets with Seed of Lightning will cause an explosion (CD: <style="accent-gn">2s</style>), dealing <style="magic">Magic DMG</style>. Any target with Seed of Lightning defeated will reduce CD time by <style="accent-gn">20s</style>.
3922.Name: Arcane! Flash Execution

3923.Desc:

3924.Desc: Resonates with the power of Elite: Goblin Wind Mage to transform into its form. Executes a frontal cone attack that deals <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> and <linktext=3001><style="ItemQuality_5">silences</style></linktext> all affected targets.

3925.Desc:
Transforms into Elite: Mighty Colossus to charge and deal Attack DMG. The longer you charge, the greater the effect on Resilience breaking. Each stack increases the Resilience Break done by 50%. (3 stacks at Tier 3 and 6 stacks at Tier 5.)
Upon the skill cast, your Resilience Break Bonus is increased for a period.

3926.Desc:
Summons Boss: Storm Goblin King to release a meteor shower at the target, dealing Magic DMG. Upon the skill cast, your Luck and DMG dealt and healing of Luck effects are increased for a period.
Tier 5: While active, trigger​ all unlocked ​passive Luck effects​ from your Plains Battle Imagines.

Casts the skill, temporarily boosting Strength, empowering the next attack to deal bonus Attack DMG in a limited area, and interrupting the target's actions.

3930.Name: Stunt! Earth Shield

3931.Desc:

[Non-stackable. Only one effect of the same type may be active]

3935.Desc:
Transforms into Boss: Golden Juggernaut, granting yourself and 10 allies Shield. When dealing DMG, the shielded targets generate Thunderstrike (CD: 0.5s), and the DMG dealt depends on the friendly ATK.
(This effect cannot stack and only one will be effective.)

3936.Desc:

Summons Elite: Lizardman Hunter to chant briefly, dealing Magic DMG.

3937.Name: Stunt! Thunder Suppress

3938.Desc: <style="accent-gn">Summons Boss</style>: Phantom Arachnocrab and transforms into a cocoon. Following a brief delay, the cocoon bursts, dealing <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> and <linktext=3000><style="ItemQuality_5">interrupting</style></linktext> the actions of the affected target. Your <style="accent-gn">Mastery</style> is increased for a period.
3938.Name: Arcane! Cocoon Tech

3939.Desc:
Summons Elite: Great Warhog to release a Lightning Orb forward, dealing Attack DMG.

3939.Name: Stunt! Lightning Orb

3940.Desc:
Summons Elite: Storm Goblin Warrior to continuously release Whirlwind Slash, dealing Attack DMG and pulling in all surrounding units.
Upon the skill cast, your Wind Bonus is increased for a period.
3940.Name: Stunt! Whirlwind Strike

3941.Desc: <style="accent-gn">Transforms into Elite</style>: Void Bzzar for a period of time, during which you can release stings and projectiles.
3941.Name: Stunt! Transform into Bee

3942.Desc:
Summons Boss: Venobzzar Incubator to continuously attack surrounding units, dealing Attack DMG. Each attack inflicts Vulnerability on the target, and your DMG dealt to the target is increased.
(This effect cannot stack and only one will be effective.)
3942.Name: Arcane! Poison Explosion

3943.Desc: <style="accent-gn">Summons Boss</style>: Iron Fang to deliver AoE <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> to nearby enemies, inflicting a <style="accent-gn">100%</style> <linktext=3004><style="ItemQuality_5">Wound</style></linktext> on all affected targets for <style="accent-gn">15s</style>.
3943.Name: Arcane! Infernal Thrust

3944.Desc: <style="accent-gn">Summons Boss</style>: Celestial Flier to charge forward, dealing Ice <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> and <linktext=3000><style="ItemQuality_5">interrupting</style></linktext> the targets' actions. After casting, your <style="accent-gn">Haste</style> is increased for a period of time.
3944.Name: Arcane! Azure Gale

3945.Desc: <style="accent-gn">Summons Boss</style>: Lizardman King to deal Ice <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> to nearby enemies and <linktext=3001><style="ItemQuality_5">Silence</style></linktext> them for <style="accent-gn">10s</style>.
3945.Name: Arcane! Silent Tide

3946.Desc:
Resonates with the power of Boss: Goblin King, summoning 1–3 goblins at random to cast skills.
Always summons 1 from Elite: Goblin Guard or Elite: Goblin Warrior.
Has a chance to additionally summon 1 Elite: Jungle Goblin Warrior.
Has a chance to summon 1 from Elite: Storm Goblin Axe or Boss: Storm Goblin King. Has a 30% chance to summon the Boss.
3946.Name: Arcane! Goblin March

3947.Desc:
Summons Elite: Muku Vanguard to charge forward, dealing Attack DMG.
Upon the skill cast, your Thunder Bonus is increased for a period.
3947.Name: Stunt! Spiral Severance

3948.Desc:
Summons Rorola, resonating with the power of ancestors to gain a damage boost for some time. Also, every 10 hits on targets grant an additional damage boost, stacking up to 5 times. Once the cap is reached, subsequent hits extend the duration of the additional boost (the duration of the Base DMG boost does not extend). Each extension adds 3s, with a maximum of 5 extensions. At the same time, grants the Life Steal effect, restoring HP equal to a portion of damage dealt (the duration can extend).
This skill holds 2 charges.
3948.Name: Arcane! Divine Reliance

3949.Desc:
Transforms into Dorothy, replacing basic attack modules and gaining Artisan's Power.
Passive: Dealing damage has a 40% chance to trigger Chain Lightning (trigger interval: at least 0.5s).
① Charges and fires a powerful shot at the target, dealing Attack DMG. Each additional charge increases the damage by 150%.
② Leaps into the air and launches a Thunderstorm Bolt at the target, dealing Attack DMG and creating a Thunderstorm Zone at the target for 7s. Thunderstorm Zone deals Attack DMG per second to enemies within and slows them.
③ Continuously unleashes Thunder Tracers, dealing Attack DMG and inflicting Paralysis on hit.
④ Fires an Oblivion Bomb, which explodes after traveling a distance or upon impact, dealing Attack DMG.
3949.Name: Arcane! Illusion Resonance

3950.Desc:
Summons Boyce to create a field of frost by concentrating ice power, dealing Ice Magic DMG.
After casting, your ATK is increased for a period of time. Each cast of a Special Attack grants an additional increase, stacking up to 5 times. At max stacks, gain a bonus to Attack SPD and Casting SPD. Performing a Special Attack extends this bonus's duration by 3s, up to a max of 5 times (The ATK bonus's duration is not affected).
This skill holds 2 charges.
3950.Name: Arcane! Allscape Sublimation

3951.Desc:
Summons Fafala to create a field.
You and allies within the field gain Final DMG Reduction and Super Armor. When you deal damage from inside the field, inflict bonus damage based on a percentage of your DEF (can trigger at most once every 1s). When you take damage, reduce the CD of this Skill by 1s (can trigger at most once every 2s).
[This effect does not stack. Only one instance of this effect can be active at a time.
3951.Name: Arcane! Guardian's Boundary

3952.Desc:
Summons Boss: Blackstone Captain to ignite flames centered on yourself, dealing Fire Attack DMG.
After casting, your Attack SPD and Casting SPD are increased for a period of time.
3952.Name: Arcane! Blazing Flames

3953.Desc:
Summons Boss: Goblin Chief to briefly charge up and unleash a forward blade wave that deals Attack DMG.
After casting, your Expertise Skill's DMG and healing are increased for a period of time. During this time, dealing damage with an Expertise Skill reduces the CD of this Skill by 0.3s (can trigger at most once every 1s).
3953.Name: Arcane! Peerless Thrust

3954.Desc:
Summons Boss: Crimson Foxen to spin and pounce on the target, dealing Attack DMG.
After casting, your Companion ATK is increased for a period of time.
3954.Name: Arcane! Phantom Ambush

3955.Desc:
Summons Boss: Cabbage Kingpin to briefly charge up and slam the ground with a hammer, dealing Attack DMG.
After casting, your passive effect is locked to the displayed sigil for 20s, and its effect is increased by 100%-150%.

3956.Desc:
Summons Boss: Flamehorn to repeatedly ram the target with its horns, dealing Attack DMG.
Grants a Luck effect: Triggering a Lucky Strike causes an explosion at the target's location, dealing Magic DMG (cooldown: 0.1s), and immediately grants the Absolute Luck effect. For the duration, Absolute Luck's cooldown becomes 5s.
3956.Name: Arcane! Flame Spirit's Fortune

3957.Desc:
Summons Boss: Basilisk to spin toward the target, dealing Attack DMG.
After casting, grants an All-Element Bonus to you and up to 10 nearby allies (prioritizing teammates) for a period of time.
(Cannot be affected by the same type of effect within 60s)
3957.Name: Arcane! Fatal Spiral

3958.Desc:
Summons Elite: Bluespine Lizard to breathe frost forward, dealing Attack DMG to targets in the area.
After casting, increases Versatility for a period of time.
3958.Name: Stunt! Frost Breath

3959.Desc:
Summons Elite: Blackstone Commander to call down lightning from the sky, dealing Magic DMG.
For a period of time after the skill is cast, when you deal damage, you will also deal additional Attack DMG to the target equal to a percentage of your Armor (can trigger at most once every 1s).

3960.Desc: <style="accent-gn">Transforms into</style> Elite: Blackstone Vanguard to perform a spinning attack that deals Fire <style="physical">Attack DMG</style>. Every stack of Blade Intent allows for an additional spin (up to <style="accent-gn">15</style> stacks). This damage benefits from all types of elemental bonuses and is not affected by passive effects.
3960.Name: Stunt! Blade Storm

3961.Desc: <style="accent-gn">Summons</style> Elite: Goblin Trickster to channel for a long time before dealing massive AoE <style="magic">Magic DMG</style>. (This skill damages enemies and up to <style="accent-gn">20</style> allies!)
3961.Name: Stunt! Carpet Bombing

Transforms the user into the selected object.
There is a pointer at the center of the Stalker's camera. Objects touched by the pointer become selected.
6504.Name: Targeted Transformation
6504.NameDesign: 潜行者专属技能-点选变身

6507.Desc: Upgrades weapons for <style="physical">15s</style> after use. Weapon attacks <style="physical">unleash a tornado</style> with a <style="physical">100% Range bonus and 50% Distance bonus</style>.
6507.Name: Security Upgrade

6508.Desc:
Fires a Super Electro Cannon forward, dealing moderate damage.
Recharges once every 10s, up to 3 charges.
"That spark dancing on your fingertips... it's the light I'll follow forever!"
6508.Name: Super Electro Cannon

6511.Desc:
Summons a Nappo Supervisor.
The Nappo Supervisor detects Stalkers within 25m, sounds an alarm, and moves toward the target.
If no Stalkers are in range, it moves randomly.
6511.Name: Nappo Supervisor

6512.Desc:
Summons a pool of water.
When a Stalker enters the pool, Skyfish appear and bite the Stalker, dealing damage equal to 50% of Total HP.
"The Skyfish just love you guys!"
6512.Name: Skyfish Domain

6513.Desc:
Makes the user gigantic for 15s.
Movement generates shockwaves, dealing high damage to nearby Stalkers.
While gigantic, movement speed is reduced and skills cannot be used.
"Drive them out! Every last one of them!"
6513.Name: Gigantification

6514.Desc:
Summons a row of waves that slowly advance.
Stalkers hit take high damage and are knocked airborne. Upon landing, their movement speed is reduced by 40% for 3s.
The waves disappear after 10s.
6514.Name: Encroaching Tide

6516.Desc:
Vines sprout and flowers bloom beneath all Stalkers on the map.
The plants entangle the Stalkers for 3s.
"...so it is!"
6516.Name: Gardener

6517.Desc:
Unleashes a Time Freeze Domain.Targets entering the domain are frozen in time. The domain lasts 5s.
Also affects other Shadow Hunters.
"This is awesome!"
6517.Name: Time Plunder

6518.Desc:
Releases fog for 15s.
Shadow Hunters entering the mist have their vision obscured.
6518.Name: Fog

6519.Desc:
Conjures an Ice Wall behind the user for 5s.
The Ice Wall blocks movement and projectiles, and reduces nearby Shadow Hunters' movement speed by 30%.
Tip: The Ice Wall crushes any targets beneath it when it appears.
6519.Name: Ice Wall

6522.Desc:
The next time damage is taken, deals 100 damage to the attacker.
The Reflection Shield effect is only visible to the user.
6522.Name: Reflection Shield

6523.Desc:
Grants immunity to the next instance of damage taken.
The No Limit effect is only visible to the user.
"Victory is assured!"
6523.Name: No Limit

6524.Desc:
Tosses a coin.50% chance to restore 10 HP; 40% chance to attract lightning and lose 10 HP; 10% chance to fully restore HP.
"A mysterious item from a certain continent!"
6524.Name: Lucky Coin

6525.Desc:
Randomly summons a Stand-In for the match:
10% chance to summon Airona: Prevents death from lethal damage, retaining 1 HP and granting invincibility for 5s;
30% chance to summon Tina: Increases movement speed by 20% when a Shadow Hunter is nearby;
30% chance to summon Boyce: 20% chance to freeze attackers for 2s;
30% chance to summon Olvera: She moves freely across the field while clearing summons. You can use this skill to transform into Olvera.
Can only be used once per match.
"Substitutes attract each other!"
6525.Name: Stand-In

6527.Desc:
Projects a copy of a similar item and restores 40 HP.
Projecting a new copy removes the previous item.
"Projection, start!"
6527.Name: Projection Magic

6528.Desc:
Burrows underground to become invincible and increase movement speed by 40% for 3s.
"I will survive, even if I must burn my life away!"
6528.Name: Arcane Art of Earth

6550.Desc: <style="emph-gn">Identifies</style> nearby Stalkers, causing them to be <style="physical">tracked</style> on radar and briefly disabling their transformation skills.
6550.Name: Radar Sense
6550.NameDesign: 逐影猎手专属技能-探测术

6551.Desc: Summons lightning, dealing <style="physical">high damage</style> to all Stalkers <style="physical">in range and exposed</style> and <style="physical">disabling their Lock skill for 30s</style>.
6551.Name: Heaven's Wrath
6551.NameDesign: 逐影猎手专属技能-天雷召来

6552.Name: Dance Off
6552.NameDesign: 逐影猎手武器技能-舞力全开

6600.Desc:
Consumes 10 HP to attack with a Wooden Stick.
If the attack hits a Stalker, restores 50 HP.
Killing a Stalker fully restores HP.
Cannot be used when HP is insufficient.
The actual damage is calculated based on the Armor of the object the Stalker has transformed into.
"A true master cares not for the quality of their weapon."
6600.Name: Solid Foundation
6600.NameDesign: 逐影猎手专属技能-木棍（普攻）

6601.Desc:

If the attack hits a Stalker, restores 50 HP.

The actual damage is calculated based on the Armor of the object the Stalker has transformed into.
Weapon Special Effect: Nearby Stalkers continuously restore HP and gain increased movement speed.
"I hope this brings you some peace..."

6601.NameDesign: 逐影猎手专属技能-法法菈武器（普攻）

33% chance to obtain Dragon Crystal: Fires 5 energy blades in all directions;
1% chance to obtain Fulgurite: Lightning strikes all Stalkers within 30m.
"Do I have to dig too?"
